page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Right margin: notes beside the first paragraph, with small type at the top and a note "b" with "ita emendat." at the bottom. Below the first paragraph: a centred small-type section heading. Then the second paragraph. Below it: footnote lines in small type with editorial brackets, one with an asterisk mark. Foot of the page: gathering signature "kk 2" centred. Running head "Fragmenta." and page number "131" at the top.

main_text.p: dicendarum caufa longinquas res {a}grauabantur, institutum est contra xii. tabu-las tacito consensu, vt litigantes non ex iure apud Prætorem manum consererent, sed ex iure manu confertum vocarent: id est alter alterum ex iure ad conserendam manum in rem, de qua ageretur, vocaret. Atque profecti simul in agrum de quo litigabatur, terræ aliquid ex eo, vti vnâ glebam, in ius in vrbem ad prætorem deterrent: & in ea gleba, tanquam in toto agro vindicarent. Idcirco Ennius significare volens bellum, non vt ad Prætorem solitum est, legitimis actionibus, neque ex iure manu confertum, sed bello ferróque, & vera vi atque solida: quod videtur dixisse con-ferens vim illam ciuilem & festucariam, quæ verbo diceretur, non quæ manu fieret cum vi bellica & cruenta. Hæc Gellius ad verbum.a lege in len[?] ginquas re[?] giones[?]
main_text.head: 2. Si iudex falsam vindiciam in causa libertatis tulerit.
main_text.p: Vindiciæ appellantur res ea, de quibus controuersia est, quod potius dicitur ius, qui fit inter eos, qui contendunt. & post. De quo verbo Cincius sic ait, Vindiciæ olim dicebantur illæ, quæ ex fundo sumptæ: in ius adlatæ erant. At Ser. Sulpicius{*} iam[lege nomine etiam]singulariter formato vindiciam esse ait [lege rem] qua de re controuersia est ab eo quod vindicatur & in xii. Si vindiciam falsam tulit Cuiacius ita emendat.
{*} [lege rei] si velit is [lege sine b litis] arbitros tres [quidam legunt, tot arbitros aeris] dato, eo-rum arbitrii fructus [quidam legunt fructi]

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge are small and partly cut off; the readings "in len", "re" and "giones" are doubtful. The bottom right note with the number of the reference is hard to read and was not fully confirmed. The asterisk marks follow the printed signs. The bracketed insertions are printed editorial additions and are kept as they stand. The head line "2. Si iudex..." is set in small centred type and is taken as a passage title.
